annotations.text:
GTS dashboard — blue + red language.

DECIDED: Direction A (Prussian). Built and shipped
into the app on 20 Aug 2026. B, C and D are kept
here as the record of what was considered.

The decision was how RED behaves. Red already means
danger here (overdue, negative, absent):

A · Prussian — blue is the structure, red stays
purely semantic. Red keeps full alarm value. ← BUILT

B · Signal — red IS the brand chrome; danger drops
to a darker oxblood. Clickable: light/dark toggle.

C · Split domains — blue = money, red = operations.

D · Nocturne — dark workspace, both as luminous data.

WHAT SHIPPED, beyond the palette:
• brass → Prussian blue (H255) as brand; primary
  buttons now take it instead of flat ink.
• Finance domain moved 268 → 262, inventory 205 → 200
  so neither collides with the brand blue.
• Chart series 4 is bronze, not red — no chart may
  spend red on an ordinary category.
• 40 colour pairs pass WCAG AA in both themes;
  contrast.mjs now exits non-zero so it can gate CI.

Shared across all four (never the variable):

• The 1.6× lead-metric band — built in the system as
  grid-metrics but never used by the old dashboard.
• A real receipts chart with baseline, gridlines and
  month labels, replacing the bare sparkline.
• Ranked alert rail: tone as a 3px leading bar, not a
  flooded background, so five alerts read as five.
• Ink foundation (H 265 near-black) kept — it is what
  keeps this from reading as a template.
• Archivo / Roboto Flex figures, tabular numerals,
  subordinate currency mark, de-emphasised decimals.

BUGS THE MOCKUPS COULDN'T SHOW, found by driving
the real app and fixed:

• .gts-progress-bar carried an infinite indeterminate
  animation, so every determinate bar in the product
  animated its own value away. Now determinate by
  default; the sweep is opt-in.
• The same bars computed to 0px wide inside
  .gts-list-figure (align-items:flex-end shrink-wraps
  a bare track). Now stretches.
• A month with no receipts drew a minimum-height bar,
  implying money arrived when none did. Now a baseline
  tick in axis grey.
• At ≤1023px the lead metric kept its 36px figure after
  the band went 2-up, overrunning its neighbour.
